title.narrative: Program to Support the Modernization of the National Tax and Customs Directorate
Programa de Apoyo a la Modernizacin de la Direccin de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales

description.narrative: Improve tax collection levels through the technological and organizational modernization of the DIAN. The specific objectives are: (i) deepen and extend the digitalization of the management and control of tax collection, which began with the implementation of the electronic invoice; (ii) development and implementation of the electronic payroll; (iii) development and implementation of the electronic fiscal audit and intelligence; (iv) development of a comprehensive risk system for tax management; (v) development of an electronic system to control the movement of cargo.

Mejorar los niveles de recaudacin tributaria, a travs de la modernizacin tecnolgica y organizacional de la DIAN. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) profundizar y extender la digitalizacin de la gestin y control de la recaudacin tributaria, la cual que se inici con la implantacin de la factura electrnica; (ii) desarrollo e implementacin de la nmina electrnica; (iii) desarrollo e implementacin de la fiscalizacin e inteligencia fiscal electrnica; (iv) desarrollo de un sistema de riesgo integral de la gestin tributaria; (v) desarrollo de un sistema electrnico de control de la movilizacin de carga.
